ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Islandia needs your location to unlock a spot when you arrive there.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Islandia uses the camera to take a photo at the spot you just collected.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Islandia reads your photo library to show the photos you took on the day you collected a spot.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Islandia saves share cards to your photo library.
